description: This file contains utility classes and objects for handling Hadoop file system operations within Spark ML image processing, including setting recursive directory flags and sampling file paths.

classes.name: RecursiveFlag
classes.description: Provides a method to temporarily set and restore Hadoop's recursive directory flag within a Spark session.

classes.name: SamplePathFilter
classes.description: A Hadoop PathFilter that allows loading a fraction of files from HDFS, with configurable sampling ratio and seed.

methods.name: withRecursiveFlag
methods.description: Sets the Hadoop recursive directory flag for a Spark session, executes a function, then restores the original flag.

methods.name: setConf
methods.description: Configures the SamplePathFilter with sampling ratio and seed from Hadoop configuration.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines whether a given Path should be accepted based on sampling ratio.

methods.name: isFile
methods.description: Checks if a Path has a file extension, indicating it is a file.

methods.name: withPathFilter
methods.description: Temporarily sets Hadoop PathFilter class with sampling parameters, executes a function, then restores previous configuration.
